notes: Two fixes for running on battery. The app now opens about as quickly unplugged as it does plugged in: Windows was slowing it down on battery, and it now asks not to be. And while documents are being read, summarised or indexed, the computer is kept awake, so a long run is no longer interrupted part-way by the machine going to sleep. The screen is still free to switch off, so you can start a run and walk away from it. Note that this cannot override Battery Saver or a power plan that limits the processor, so if it still feels slow unplugged, check whether Battery Saver is on. Separately, the AI gateway is now called just that throughout, rather than the Lex AI gateway.
